comment: Hand-written ideas (by Claude or a human). Same format as generated ideas. These are tried before generated ones. Fields: order (variable names, last one is solved exactly), atoms (subset of n, n2, n3, v, nv, n2v, vv, nvv), mult (coefficients for the atom), T (offset range), D (divisor range), note.

ideas.note: solve the smallest unknown last; allow 2n and 3n type atoms
larger products as building blocks for the middle unknown
Claude: x = (n + t)/d with large t, then y = (n x + s)/t; narrow atoms so a deep search is affordable
